notes.title: ACHIEVEMENTS ARE HERE!
notes.content: Upon request, we've created achievements! Show us your awesome power by unlocking them all!

notes.title: Leaderboards now available!
notes.content: Major new update in Nova Slash! Compete with the power and skill of other players by jumping to the top of the leaderboards!

notes.title: Motion Blur OPTIONAL and fix Mac build
notes.content: If you were feeling sick while playing the game because of too much blur, you can now turn off motion blur for less stress on your eyes! There was also an error with the Mac version of the game that we fixed.

notes.title: Motion Blur can be disabled!
notes.content: If you were feeling sick while playing the game because of too much blur, you can now turn off motion blur for less stress on your eyes!

notes.title: Motion blur OPTIONAL now!
notes.content: I didn't realize how many people detested motion blur in video games! Forgive me. My background started in animated films and motion blur augmented the look to be less jarring. I didn't realize it made people weary in games So now you have the option to remove motion blur!

notes.title: Motion blur optional now
notes.content: I didn't realize how many people detested motion blur in video games! Forgive me. My background started in animated films and motion blur augmented the look to be less jarring. I didn't realize it made people weary in gamesːsteammockingː So now you have the option to remove motion blur!

notes.title: Update 7/10/22
notes.content:
-More in-depth tutorial
-Fixed collisions
-Camera can now be moved/rotated
-Fixed minor bugs

notes.title: Cosmic Ascended.
notes.content:
-Cosmis the Stellar can now transform into his celestial state, making him Cosmic Ascended! (R1 or B on keyboard to activate)

-New dynamic camera when you takedown an enemy!

Join the discord and discuss your ideas about the game!
[url=https://discord.gg/fGj7fstTnh]Discord[/url]

notes.title: New languages and more!
notes.content:
Nova Slash now supports the following languages:
-English
-Spanish
-Arabic
-Russian
-Turkish
-Korean
-Chinese
-German

Also collision issues were fixed!

notes.title: New character transformation coming soon!
notes.content: Hello players! Check out what we've been working on! This transformation is far from complete, but check out the move set so far! This guy will be ready in 1 1/2 months, so if you don't have Nova Slash yet get it now! It's now available in bundle with Kombo King at 60% OFF! [previewyoutube=2ddfA2BSA44;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update 7/1/22
notes.content:
Hey guys! We're always looking for ways to make Nova Slash the best action game out there! We fixed a problem where the new soldier enemy didn't take damage when they were idling. There will be an even bigger update in the coming weeks... Let us know what you think of the game here or on the discord!

Icuzo

notes.title: All bugs have been addressed (5/28/22)
notes.content: We had major complaints about the game not performing well because of bugs and glitches. We have combed the game for all bugs and had a QA team test for anymore bugs that may have been overlooked. We're extremely sorry for the inconvenience and we urge you to try the game in its now most optimal state.

notes.title: Addressing major issues in game
notes.content: We are currently addressing major issues that are affecting the game's experience. If you've reviewed game, we'll be addressing all problems in the game to give you a better experience. We apologize for the inconvenience and we urge you to review the game once the update is out.

notes.title: Update 5/15/22
notes.content:
-Boss glitch where they take no damage is fixed
-Enemy glitch where they take no damage is fixed
-Noven's transformation glitch fixed
